paper.title_en: Doubly-scaled planar ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM \& Carroll Holography
paper.abstract_en: Okuda and Penedones (OP) \cite{Okuda:2010ym} showed the existence of a double scaling limit of four point correlators in ${\cal N}=4$ Supersymmetric Yang Mills (SYM) theory in four spacetime dimensions (4$d$) dual to the flat space limit of tree-level string amplitude in $\mathbb{R}^{1,9}$ with external kinematics in $\mathbb{R}^{1,4}$. In this paper, we show that the resulting boundary correlators can be used to define a 4d Carrollian conformal field theory (CFT) on future null infinity (${\I}^{+}$). This is done by mapping the set of correlators in ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM theory (in the double scaling limit) to ${\I}^{+}$, which is the conformal boundary of all asymptotically flat spacetimes. A Carroll CFT thus emerges in the infinite 't Hooft coupling limit of ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM theory. We extend the OP analysis to higher point functions and show how the Gram conditions on flat space amplitude put constraints on the double scaling limit of SYM correlators. We then use the soft factorization theorem for dilatonic string amplitude to write a recursion relation for $\frac{1}{2}$ BPS sector of ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM theory in the double scaling limit. Finally, we show that the essential ideas underlying such a double scaling limit can be used as a tool-kit to build a class of Carrollian correlators, and hence define a Carrollian CFT, via certain integral transforms of flat space amplitudes of non-gravitational effective field theories.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了一种通过双标度极限和Carroll共形场论定义渐近平坦时空全息描述的新方法，属于广义相对论基础领域的前沿研究，具有高度的理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 双标度平面 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论 & Carroll 全息
decision.abstract_zh: Okuda 和 Penedones (OP) \cite{Okuda:2010ym} 证明了四维时空 (4$d$) 中 ${\cal N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯 (SYM) 理论中四点关联函数存在一个双标度极限，该极限对偶于 $\mathbb{R}^{1,9}$ 中树级弦振幅的平坦空间极限，其外部运动学位于 $\mathbb{R}^{1,4}$。在本文中，我们证明了由此产生的边界关联函数可用于定义未来零无穷 (${\I}^{+}$) 上的 4 维 Carroll 共形场论 (CFT)。这是通过将 ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM 理论（在双标度极限中）的一组关联函数映射到 ${\I}^{+}$（所有渐近平坦时空的共形边界）来实现的。因此，在 ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM 理论的无限 't Hooft 耦合极限中出现了一个 Carroll CFT。我们将 OP 分析扩展到更高点函数，并展示了平坦空间振幅上的 Gram 条件如何对 SYM 关联函数的双标度极限施加约束。然后，我们利用膨胀弦振幅的软因子分解定理，为双标度极限中 ${\cal N} = 4$ SYM 理论的 $\frac{1}{2}$ BPS 扇区编写了一个递归关系。最后，我们表明，这种双标度极限的基本思想可以作为一个工具包，通过非引力有效场论的平坦空间振幅的某些积分变换，来构建一类 Carroll 关联函数，从而定义 Carroll CFT。
